altText: Text slide; Dar members don't come back for the machines. Five things that decide it before the first set.
Text slide; Rule 1. Karibu is the first rep. A greeting at the door. By name after week one. Nobody trains hard where they feel like a stranger.
Text slide; Rule 2. Plan for the power cut. A fan that works, water that runs, light when TANESCO lets you down. Members remember the gym that was ready.
Text slide; Rule 3. The changing room is the review. A clean floor, a hook for the bag, a mirror that isn't cracked. That is what they describe to a friend.
Text slide; Rule 4. Let them pay the way Dar pays. M-Pesa or Airtel Money at the desk, receipt on the phone. Not "come back tomorrow with cash".
Text slide; Rule 5. Someone on the floor who corrects form. Without being asked, without selling a package. That is the staff members talk about.
Text slide; FitFlex scores every gym on all of this before it joins. Equipment, amenities, facility and staff. Not just the weights.
Text slide; Own a gym in Dar es Salaam? Comment PARTNER. We'll DM you how FitFlex works.

Own a gym in Dar? Comment PARTNER.
